ServiceToken.description: Expiring/revocable user service token; never a GitHub credential. Opaque IDs do not confer access.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Persist with the logical operation. Scope: user + method + route; seven-day retention.

UploadExpires.description: Upload expiry as an HTTP-date, not JSON RFC3339.

NoStore.description: Private mutable metadata must not be cached by intermediaries.

Problem.description: Structured error. Retry only when retryable and honor Retry-After.

Ticks.description: Signed integer ticks, encoded as a string to preserve 64-bit precision.

FrameRange.description: Zero-based presentation indices, [start,end). Semantic validation requires start < end <= asset.frame_count.

Timing.description: Frame i PTS = start_pts + i * frame_duration_ticks. Time base times duration must equal reciprocal frame rate. Timecode is informational.

InputColour.description: M1 canonical RGB PNG input; transform_id identifies adapter colour conversion, or identity-srgb-v1.

AssetCreate.description: Files must contain exactly frame_count unique contiguous indices 0..frame_count-1. Validate advertised byte/pixel/frame limits before reserving storage.

Asset.description: Canonical digest covers verified media bytes, ordered frame mapping and normalized metadata. It is present after validation; active jobs pin the source beyond its scheduled TTL.

JobCreate.description: M1 preview and full share the same native-quality execution. Preview changes delivered range only. Reject unavailable revisions/profiles; never silently select another one.

Progress.description: Counters describe the current attempt/phase; stage phases can interleave. ETA is null until calibrated.

OutputFile.description: Alpha: single stored channel [Y], interpreted as coverage/alpha. Foreground: [R,G,B], linear_srgb, straight. Native EXR channel names are preserved for byte identity.

Result.description: Published atomically only after complete export and checksum validation. Exactly one alpha and fg file for each emitted source frame; preserve source PTS. URLs require bearer authentication.

Deletion.description: Access is revoked immediately. Poll the dedicated deletion status URL after the source becomes a tombstone; deleted means physical cleanup and dependent-result removal have completed. Failure leaves access revoked.

qualification.description: Identifies the completed validation matrix behind the advertised profile, not a claim of exactness on arbitrary future hardware.

Profile.description: Immutable qualified profile; unadvertised settings cannot be chosen by clients. Exactness is limited to qualified inputs/environment. Different profiles are not assumed mutually equivalent.

Limits.description: Deployment policy, not a benchmark capacity guarantee. Input limits also apply to each advertised profile.

Retention.description: TTL clocks are defined in the architecture; accepted jobs pin input bytes. Polling does not extend retention.

Capabilities.description: Advertise only implemented/qualified paths. Media and job contract version is distinct from model/runtime revision and worker capacity.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details; sanitize detail. Job failures can carry this same structured record.

ServerTimings.description: Optional measured durations from one server monotonic clock, for the current/final attempt. Null means unavailable. No duration is computed by subtracting client and server wall clocks.

queue_seconds.description: Durable job acceptance to worker start; includes waiting for an available/ready worker.

service_seconds.description: Worker start through complete export, checksum validation and result publication.

model_load_seconds_in_service.description: Model loading inside this job service interval; zero for an already loaded model.

inference_start_monotonic.description: Private pilot diagnostics on the same server boot clock; never subtract a client timestamp.
